scope: Closed local named XSD simple restrictions for inert ACCDT stored table schemas and rows

checks.command: cargo test --locked --offline -j2 -p tablecraft-access --lib --test recomputed_calculations --test calculation_preview --test recomputed_view_conformance

acceptance: All 15 existing primitive domains preserve exact cells through named restrictions across UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM and UTF-16 LE/BE package variants.
Forward/shared references, exact XML type names, inline derived restrictions and inherited/narrowed String/Binary/Decimal facets.
Every named declaration preflighted, including unused types; cycles, duplicates, unknown bases/namespaces, widening and unsupported constructs refuse before record decoding.
256/257 named-type count and 64/65 reference depth, with both declaration orders so memoized bases cannot bypass the limit.
Nullable stored rows, metadata-only binding before malformed rows, buffered no-callback failure, shared limits and cancellation/retry.
List Definition agreement remains based on resolved carrier/facets; even valid row values cannot hide mismatching declared bounds.

excluded_initial_checks.reason: All 59 library and 21 preview tests passed; companion recomputed target had four failures from a checked Projection::Field versus Expression composition defect, corrected by its owner before final rerun. No named-type production or test correction.

All 59 library, 21 preview and 5 implementation tests passed; one companion conformance golden expected Int64 instead of existing materialized overflow Double. Test owner corrected the golden after baseline verification, no runtime change.

counting_notes: The combined final command runs 59 library tests, including 52 template tests and 7 other library tests, plus 21+5+7 integration tests. Scoped template totals are 52 including 8 new; the combined 92 are not an additional disjoint test set.
No named-type runtime corrections were required after its initial source check and all eight new controls passed on the initial and final combined runs.
limitations: Engineering stored XML/XSD read support; native Access-created template instantiation and execution qualification remain unrun.
No imports/includes, external namespaces, named complex types, XSD lists/unions, extra facets, default filling, code generation or provider/network execution.
Existing primitive value/carrier and package/XML/table ceilings remain unchanged; this is not a general XSD implementation.

independent_replay.qualification: Original synthetic ZIP/XML stored-cell model, actual Notes and typed values; no Access-created template or new lexical-boundary qualification.
